Package io.github.jabrena.juno.robotics.navigation

@NullMarked package io.github.jabrena.juno.robotics.navigation
Board-independent motion coordination. DifferentialDrive combines two DCMotor instances, while DifferentialDriveOdometry combines encoders and an inertial sensor and HeadingHoldController applies heading corrections without depending on a motor protocol or device implementation.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    io.github.jabrena.juno.robotics
    Board-independent motor and sensor contracts.
  • Class
    Description
    DetourPlanner
    Plans a mission's path for a Navigator and drives it around obstacles found on the way: the planner leJOS's PathFinder feeds a navigator through its WaypointListener, re-planning when the navigator says a leg ended at an obstacle, which leJOS leaves to the program.
    DifferentialDrive
    Coordinates two independently controlled motors as a differential drive.
    DifferentialDriveOdometry
    Updates a caller-owned pose from two wheel encoders and a heading sensor.
    DriveGeometry
    Fixed geometry and encoder ratios for a two-wheel differential drive.
    GyroDifferentialPilot
    A Pilot over two EncoderMotors whose power the program sets directly, such as a Powered Up hub's, that closes both loops itself with a DirectionFinder, a GyroHeading for instance.
    GyroHeading
    A DirectionFinder over a Gyroscope: a virtual thread of its own reads the gyroscope's angular velocity every GyroHeading.SAMPLE_MILLIS and integrates it, so the direction keeps counting while the program waits on something else, such as an infrared round trip to an RCX.
    GyroRegulatedDifferentialDrive
    A RegulatedDifferentialDrive that holds its heading with a DirectionFinder, such as a GyroHeading.
    HeadingHoldController
    Applies a bounded proportional correction to keep a differential drive on a target heading.
    MoveOutcome
    Why a Pilot's last move ended, and so why a Navigator's leg did.
    NavigationListener
    Hears a Navigator's progress along its path, as leJOS's listener of the same name does.
    Navigator
    Drives a robot through a path of Waypoints, as leJOS's Navigator does: for each waypoint it turns to face the point, travels to it, and turns to the waypoint's heading when one is required.
    ObstacleDetector
    Says whether something is in the robot's way, read by a Pilot on its own thread while it travels: leJOS's FeatureDetector without the thread of its own, which a board's few thread slots cannot spare.
    Pilot
    Moves a robot straight and turns it in place, as leJOS's MoveController with its rotation does: the moves a Navigator drives a path with.
    Pose
    Mutable, allocation-free planar pose for a differential-drive robot, Cartesian as leJOS's pose and a DirectionFinder's direction are: heading zero points along +x, the heading grows counter-clockwise, and +y is to the left of heading zero.
    RangeObstacleDetector
    An ObstacleDetector over a forward-facing RangeFinder, such as a Grove Ultrasonic Ranger: blocked once confirmReadings readings in a row are nearer than stopMillimetres, and clear again only once a reading is beyond clearMillimetres or finds no echo.
    RegulatedDifferentialDrive
    Drives a two-wheel robot by distance and heading, with its wheels regulated by a RegulatedPair (such as an RCX pair).
    Waypoint
    A point a Navigator drives to, in the pose's Cartesian millimetres, optionally with the heading the robot must face there, as leJOS's Waypoint.
    WaypointListener
    Receives a path one waypoint at a time from whatever plans it, as leJOS's interface of the same name does: a Navigator implements it, and a planner such as DetourPlanner feeds it.
